    AI Mode reply for zakat calculator business stock

    Primary Zakat calculations for business inventory and shares are available through platforms like the Zakat Calculator for Stocks and Funds or the Business Assets Zakat Calculator. 
    Zakat on business stock (inventory) and stock market shares (equities) is calculated at 2.5% of your net zakatable wealth once it crosses the minimum threshold (Nisab). 
    📊 Business Inventory (Stock-in-Trade)
    • ✅ Zakatable: Goods held for resale, raw materials, and work-in-progress.
    • 💡 Valuation: Value inventory at its current market selling price on your Zakat anniversary date.
    • ⚠️ Exempt: Fixed assets like machinery, office buildings, and delivery vehicles. 
    📈 Stock Market Shares (Equities)
    • 📌 Short-Term Trading: Pay 2.5% on the full prevailing market value if shares are bought for quick resale. 
    • 📌 Long-Term Investment: Pay 2.5% only on your proportional share of the company's liquid/zakatable assets (cash, inventory, receivables). 
    • 💡 Proxy Method: If company asset breakdowns are unknown, a common scholarly approximation allows applying 2.5% to 30%–40% of the total portfolio market value. 
    🗓️ Step-by-Step Calculation Formula
    1. Add Assets: Total your business cash, trade receivables, and market value of inventory/trading stock.
    2. Subtract Liabilities: Deduct immediate short-term debts, payroll due, and taxes payable within the lunar year.
    3. Check Nisab: Compare your net remainder to the threshold of 85 grams of gold (approx. $12,112 USD / local equivalent).
    4. Pay Due Amount: Multiply your net qualifying total by 0.025 (2.5%). 
    If you share your approximate inventory value, cash reserves, and short-term debts, I can run a precise calculation model for your business.
